title: Run a script or command with uv
summary: Use `uv run` to execute a Python script or a command within the project's isolated environment. This ensures the correct dependencies are used.

steps.explain: Replace <SCRIPT_OR_COMMAND> with the path to your Python script or the command you want to run.

placeholders.name: SCRIPT_OR_COMMAND
placeholders.description: Path to a Python script or a command to execute.
